page.content:
Pull-string sheriff and anxious leader of Andy's toys.

How Woody connects

  • Work: Toy Story — Toy Story is Woody's first film as Andy's favorite.
  • Faction: Andy's toys — Woody is the pull-string leader of Andy's toys.
  • Character: Buzz Lightyear — Woody and Buzz become partners after the rivalry.

What is Woody?

Woody is the cowboy doll who runs Andy's room, panics when Buzz arrives, and spends three films learning how to let a kid grow.

Key threads lead to Toy Story, Andy's toys and Buzz Lightyear.
